Initial release of dingtalk-calendar skill

- Provides DingTalk calendar management, including creating events, querying free/busy status, meeting room booking, and user/meeting room lookup.
- Requires installation and configuration of mcporter CLI and MCP server connections for DingTalk Calendar and Contacts.
- Supports CLI commands for creating, updating, and deleting calendar events, as well as checking calendar availability and scheduling meetings.
- Includes detailed usage instructions and examples for typical scheduling and meeting workflows.
